Didem hoca has lots of qualities. She is organized, states objectives clearly and makes sure that you understand the topic. She also cares a lot for her students and their learning, she may make time just to hear her students read french outside the class. She consistently informs us of french related activities that carry a lot of importance in our academic lives. She makes sure that everyone in class participates, and no one is left out in any of the activities. She tries to arrange the homework deadlines so that the students can actually make time for the homework rather then just scrambling things into it due to having many exams. Overall, she is a great teacher; I wouldn’t have picked french as a course if it wasn’t for her.
Bad sides, (this is actually good for a student, makes sure you study beforehand), even if you don’t know the answer she will help you while still expecting you to continue your answer. There is no saying “Hocam, I don’t know the answer.” Great teacher. Learnt a lot!
